title: BODHI: Do LLMs Branch Out and Discover Heterogeneous Inferences?
abstract: arXiv:2608.02867v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), whether it expands reasoning capabilities or primarily improves sampling efficiency remains debated. In this paper, we investigate the nature of test-time exploration in RLVR-trained LLMs by employing controlled maze-solving experiments and BODHI-TREEs, a reusable representation that groups mathematical reasoning segments based on semantic equivalence. These probes help delineate preferences between stylistic variations and semantically distinct continuations. We show that RLVR-trained models exhibit lower candidate preference entropy between semantically distinct continuations than their distilled counterparts, and complementary sampling experiments show lower empirical semantic entropy and fewer observed branches under equal sampling budgets. translated_title: BODHI：大语言模型能否分支探索并发现异构推理？
translated_abstract: 尽管基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已经提升了对大语言模型（LLM）的推理性能，但它究竟是扩展了推理能力，还是主要提高了采样效率，这一问题仍然存在争议。在本文中，我们通过受控的迷宫求解实验和 BODHI-TREEs（一种可复用的表示方法，基于语义等价性对数学推理片段进行分组）来研究 RLVR 训练的大语言模型在测试时探索的本质。这些探测方法有助于刻画模型在风格变化与语义不同的续写之间的偏好。我们表明，与蒸馏模型相比，RLVR 训练的模型在语义不同的续写之间表现出更低的候选偏好熵；互补的采样实验表明，在相同的采样预算下，模型表现出更低的经验语义熵和更少的观测分支。因此，策略集中化不仅体现在风格层面……
tldr: 研究发现RLVR训练的大语言模型相比蒸馏模型表现出更低的语义多样性和更少的推理分支，表明其推理性能提升主要来自采样效率的改善而非推理能力的真正扩展。
en_tdlr: RLVR-trained LLMs exhibit lower semantic diversity and fewer reasoning branches than distilled models, suggesting their improved reasoning performance stems mainly from enhanced sampling efficiency rather than genuinely expanded reasoning capabilities.
